content:
srini: Heads up — reported billing anomaly during a canary rollback. looks like provisional counts doubled when a truncated toolcall was retried and routed to a different host.
jess: session id?
srini: sess=org-9932, time=2026-03-23T11:20:00Z. console shows provisional=320 confirmed=160. two provisional events 180ms apart.
mike: sounds like race between router grace-window and sidecar prefetch TTL. warm handoff allowed a new owner to emit provisional before original owner cleared.
jess: do we currently tag provisional with origin host? we need provenance to dedupe.
mike: not consistently. proposal: add claim_nonce + claim_origin to provisional ledger writes. dedupe in ingestion by (session, claim_nonce). also add small TTL dedupe cache (30m).
billing-bot: [alert] provisional-spike org-9932 count=320 confirmed=160
srini: customer alarmed because alerting rules used provisional. short-term fix: tweak alerting to ignore provisional-only spikes or require confirmation within 5 minutes to fire.
jess: agree. I'll patch the alerting rule to exclude provisional-only alerts for now and add a tooltip: "Provisional tokens pending reconciliation".
mike: backend changes: router will start generating claim_nonce and include it in heartbeats; prefetch will propagate it. ingestion will skip duplicates and log when skipping. quick SQL to find duplicates:
SELECT claim_nonce, COUNT(*) cnt, SUM(provisional_tokens) tokens FROM billing_events WHERE session_id='org-9932' AND event_time > now() - interval '1 hour' GROUP BY claim_nonce HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
srini: can we also expose /internal/billing/provenance?session=org-9932&window=1h to help oncall triage?
mike: yes, small internal endpoint returning counts by claim_origin and claim_nonce. rate-limited.
jess: owners: mike=router+ingest, jess=alerting+console. timeline: alerting change today, router flag canary tomorrow, ingestion dedupe early next week. I'll file runbook steps: 1) on provisional spike, call internal provenance endpoint 2) if duplicate nonces present, escalate to platform.
billing-bot: [deploy] alerting-hotfix/hide-provisional deployed to canary 15:04 :white_check_mark:
srini: thanks. I'll update customer and add tickets to rollout board.
